title: Word flips across a hairline rule
summary: A thin rule appears on white, one short line rises out from behind it, leans a few degrees, flips under the rule like a hinge, leans the other way, then slips back behind it. One line, one rule, four seconds.
use_when: A short title card or chapter marker where the type is the whole picture
Introducing a product name or a two-word label in a calm, minimal voice
A loopable lower-energy sting between longer scenes
Silent autoplay feeds that need motion without SFX

look.type_style: light-regular grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, cap height ~4 % H, one line of 2 words; 1 px grey hairline 49 % W at frame centre

sfx.event: line rises out of the rule

structure.shot: empty white frame; a thin grey horizontal rule fades in at centre, 49 % of the width
structure.motion: rule opacity 0 -> 1 over f4-f6, easings.linear 3 fr; full width from its first frame (no draw-on)

structure.shot: one line, 2 words (name or label), rises out from behind the rule and sits just above it, centred
structure.motion: line rises out of a clip mask whose bottom edge is the rule, whole line, f6-f9, easings.outExpo 3 fr (overshoot not measurable); then rotateZ 0 -> -4 deg (counter-clockwise) f9-f30, easings.inOutSine, holds, returns to 0 deg by f42

structure.shot: the same line flips across the rule and now hangs below it
structure.motion: hinge flip: rotateX around the rule, line above -> line below, f43-f47, easings.inOutSine 4 fr, letters squash and fade at the rule; below, rotateZ 0 -> +4 deg (clockwise) f48-f78 easings.inOutSine, holds, back to 0 deg by f95

structure.shot: the line slips back up through the rule and is gone; only the rule holds on white to the end
structure.motion: exit f96-f99: line rises into the rule and is clipped away, easings.inExpo 3 fr; rule holds untouched 35 fr (f99-f134), no fade out

params.brand: any brand.json: text font for the line, fg for the type, muted for the rule, bg
params.content.line: one line, 1-3 words, fits inside the rule width (~80 % of it)
params.timing.flipAt: frame of the hinge flip (default 43 at 30 fps)
params.timing.exitAt: frame the line slips back into the rule (default 96)
params.tilt.deg: lean during each hold, sign flips with the side (default 4)
params.rule.width: rule width as a share of frame width (default 0.49)

notes: Measured from a 30 fps strip of the centre region. Rule never moves or scales (same width in every sheet cell); motion.json zoom/pan values come from the small tilting text, not a camera. Lean is about 4 deg (+-1 deg) each side, opposite sign above and below the rule. Flip is 4 fr, entrance and exit 3 fr: keep them short, the holds carry the piece. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): rule-hinge-flip, rest-tilt. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
